- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The PR DESCRIPTION and changelog fragment `4350-adopt-active-review-run.md` both describe a behavior change in Phase 4b of `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml`: it now adopts an already-queued review run for the smoke PR when one exists, dispatches only when no eligible active run is found, then pins and polls one exact run ID. The refactor moves from the `ADOPTED_REVIEW_RUN_ID=$(gh_api_with_retry … || ADOPTED_REVIEW_RUN_ID=""` pattern to `RETRY_ACTIVE_RUN` / `RETRY_RUN_ID` / `RETRY_BASELINE_ID`. New contract tests are added at lines 185-229 of `tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_review_blocked_budget.py` (using the `_phase4b_retry` slice) but the dead tests that still assert the OLD pattern were left in place. The diff's `@@ -174,6 +182,53 @@` hunk appends after the named-budget test without removing them, so the implementation and the existing test suite no longer agree.
  Expected change site: `tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_review_blocked_budget.py` lines 318-376 — the helpers `_adopt_jq` (which `re.search`es for `ADOPTED_REVIEW_RUN_ID=\$\(gh_api_with_retry`), `_phase4b` (used only by the dead tests), `BAIT`/`PRE_BAIT`, and the three tests `test_phase4b_adopts_oldest_active_review_run_instead_of_dispatching`, `test_phase4b_ignores_prior_completed_and_foreign_sha_runs`, `test_phase4b_dispatches_only_when_no_run_is_adopted`.
  Evidence of absence: `grep -rn "ADOPTED_REVIEW_RUN_ID" .` in the worktree returns only the five references inside the test file (lines 319, 368, 373, 374, 375 of `tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_review_blocked_budget.py`); `git diff` of `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml` shows the identifier was renamed to `RETRY_ACTIVE_RUN` / `RETRY_RUN_ID` / `RETRY_BASELINE_ID` with no surviving alias. The renamed hunk `@@ -2290,28 +2291,31 @@ jobs:` deletes the inline `ADOPTED_REVIEW_RUN_ID=$(gh_api_with_retry … || ADOPTED_REVIEW_RUN_ID="")` block at the previous lines 2324-2356 of the workflow. Three concrete failure paths on the next `pytest` invocation: `_adopt_jq` at line 319 will return `None` from `re.search` and trip `assert match is not None, "Phase 4b must look up an already-active review run before dispatching"`; `phase4b.index("ADOPTED_REVIEW_RUN_ID=$(gh_api_with_retry")` at line 368 raises `ValueError`; `phase4b.index('if [[ "${ADOPTED_REVIEW_RUN_ID}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then')` at line 373 raises `ValueError`; the membership check `assert '"repos/${TEST_REPO}/actions/runs/${ADOPTED_REVIEW_RUN_ID}"' in phase4b` at line 375 fails because the only remaining `actions/runs/${…REVIEW…}` reference in the workflow now expands to `${RETRY_RUN_ID}` at lines 2467-2470 of the post-refactor file.

- NOTE
  The new tests `test_phase4b_dispatches_only_without_active_work_and_pins_one_run` (line 204) explicitly assert `assert ".head_sha == $bait_sha" not in registration_selection` and `assert ".head_sha == $retry_sha" not in registration_selection` — the deliberate omission of a `head_sha` filter from the post-dispatch jq selector at lines 2458-2464 of the workflow is by design (the design comment at lines 2306-2313 documents "the branch-scoped baseline identifies the oldest new run even if the branch advanced"), and the 90-second hardcoded registration deadline is a single-site magic number with no documented misconfiguration path. Neither rises to a runtime-correctness defect.
  The `RETRY_BASELINE_ID` jq expression `[.workflow_runs[].id] | max // 0` at line 2352 is preceded by the schema guard at lines 2337-2351 that asserts `(.workflow_runs | type == "array")`, so the empty/non-array case is already excluded; `max // 0` correctly returns `0` for the empty-array case via jq's null-coalesce semantics, and the subsequent `^[0-9]+$` regex check at line 2353 accepts `0`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
